results.title: (no transformer/Whisper-on-Silbo result found)
results.note: No 2024-2025 result pairing Whisper/transformer/audio-MLLM with Silbo; the only published Silbo ASR remains the 2023 HMM-GMM system. So a *modern unified audio-MLLM* whistle->text+speech pipeline appears genuinely undone, even though whistle->text ASR per se is not first-mover.

prior_art_found: Jakubiak (2023, Interspeech) 'Whistle-to-text: Automatic recognition of the Silbo Gomero whistled language' - explicitly the FIRST ASR system for a whistled language; performs whistle->text on Silbo Gomero using HMM-GMM. Directly contradicts the candidate's 'first automatic whistle->text/speech pipeline' claim.
OpenSLR 137 'Silbo Gomero Speech Corpus' - public 49-min, 4-whistler corpus used for that ASR.
'Whistler Identification in Whistled Spanish (Silbo)' (2025, Springer) - additional ML work on Silbo (speaker ID).
Multiple 'AI-powered' Silbo Gomero translator web tools (anythingtranslate.com, rizzai.ai) and a GitHub Silbo<->Spanish translator - mostly text->whistle / rule-based, i.e. adjacent applications.
2025 Ciencia Cognitiva survey: ML on whistle corpora 'beginning to... enable automatic transcription or education apps' - the domain is actively being worked, not untouched.
verdict_reason: The candidate's headline first-application claim - the 'first automatic whistle->text/speech pipeline' for Silbo Gomero - is directly falsified by Jakubiak (2023, Interspeech), which is explicitly the first-ever ASR for a whistled language and performs whistle->text on Silbo using a public corpus (OpenSLR 137). Additional ML work (2025 whistler-ID) and live AI translator tools further show the domain is not under-served at the 'has anyone applied ML/AI' level. The technique class differs (modern unified audio MLLM vs. HMM-GMM) and the spoken-Spanish *synthesis/translation* leg may be incrementally new, but the core technique-agnostic application (automatic Silbo whistle transcription) already exists, so this is not a true first-mover opportunity and is rejected.

life_domain: Glassblowing (working glass at the right viscosity by eye) - Traditional craft & trades

searches.query: neural operator glassblowing viscosity reheat PDE surrogate real-time

results.title: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operators for Stable Long Horizon PDE Rollouts (arXiv 2602.18801)
results.note: The SGNO paper itself; benchmarked on APEBench turbulent flows, reaction-diffusion, climate dynamics. No glass/glassblowing application - confirms the technique has not been pointed at hot-glass working.

results.title: (no glassblowing+neural-operator result)
results.note: Generic multiscale neural PDE surrogates; no result couples neural operators / PDE surrogates with glassblowing viscosity/reheat. The exact pairing appears undone.

searches.query: machine learning glassblowing temperature viscosity control molten glass forming

results.title: Temperature Control of Digital Glass Forming Processes (arXiv 2604.00135)
results.note: March 2026 paper: real-time temperature-control system that fuses thermal-camera + visual-camera + process data and a data-driven dynamic temperature model to keep glass in its working range. Same core problem (hold working-range temperature via thermal sensing) but for laser Digital Glass Forming (additive), not artisan hand glassblowing, and uses a closed-loop controller, not a neural-operator forward forecast.

results.title: ViscNet: Neural network for predicting fragility index and temperature-dependency of viscosity (arXiv 2007.03719)
results.note: ML already predicts glass viscosity vs temperature (material/composition level). Shows viscosity-temperature modeling by NN is established, but it is not a real-time spatial-field forecast for a working gather.

results.note: PINN/NN transient-heat-conduction temperature-field surrogates are mature (also ship-hull line heating, additive manufacturing). The capability (fast temperature-field surrogate) exists generically but none target cooling glass for a glassblower.

results.title: Advanced Deep Operator Networks to Predict Multiphysics Fields in Materials Processing and Additive Manufacturing (arXiv 2403.14795)
results.note: DeepONet predicting thermal/mechanical fields in casting/DED additive manufacturing - neural operators ARE used as thermal surrogates in materials processing, but not for glassblowing reheat timing.

results.note: Thermal cameras for glass are commercial, but aimed at industrial glass *furnaces/forming lines*, not an artisan reheat assistant. The sensing hardware exists; the PDE-surrogate artisan-guidance use does not.

results.title: Optris PI640 G7 Thermal Imaging Camera for Glass
results.note: Glass-tuned IR camera (200-1500 C). Confirms cheap thermal sensing of hot glass is feasible (candidate's hardware premise holds) but is sold for measurement, not forward viscosity forecasting.

searches.query: artisan glassblower augmented reality AI assistant working temperature guidance craft hot glass

results.title: AI in Glassblowing Videos: Automated Temperature Zone Monitoring (ReelMind blog)
results.note: Marketing/SEO blog claims AI thermal cameras classify glass zones as 'workable/transitional/critical' and alert artists via wearables, and cites a 'Corning Smart Glassblowing Lab' real-time-feedback result. This mirrors the candidate's 'reheat now / leaving workable band' concept BUT is promotional, unverifiable, and describes current-state classification, not a PDE-surrogate forward forecast. Low evidentiary weight.

results.title: Corning GlassWorks AI solutions (LinkedIn, Mar 2025)
results.note: Corning 'GlassWorks AI' is a real industrial glass-manufacturing AI line, not an artisan hand-glassblowing reheat assistant; supports the marketing-claim provenance but is not the candidate's application.

prior_art_found: Temperature Control of Digital Glass Forming Processes (arXiv 2604.00135, Mar 2026): real-time thermal-camera + data-driven dynamic model temperature control to keep glass in its working range - the same 'hold the workable temperature band via thermal sensing' problem, but for laser additive Digital Glass Forming, via a closed-loop controller (NOT a neural-operator PDE-surrogate forecast for a hand gaffer).
ViscNet (arXiv 2007.03719) and physics-informed ML viscosity-temperature models: ML predicts glass viscosity vs temperature at the material level (not spatial real-time field forecast).

Neural-operator / PINN transient-heat-conduction temperature-field surrogates broadly established (e.g. DeepONet for casting/additive manufacturing, PINN temperature-field CNNs) - technique class is mature for thermal fields but not applied to glassblowing.
Commercial glass-tuned thermal cameras (AMETEK Land NIR-B-Glass, Optris PI640 G7) confirm the sensing premise but are industrial-furnace measurement tools.

ReelMind marketing blogs claim AI thermal 'workable/transitional/critical' zone classification + wearable alerts for glassblowers and reference a Corning 'Smart Glassblowing Lab'; unverifiable/promotional, and describe current-state classification, not forward PDE-surrogate forecasting.
verdict_reason: Strong adversarial pressure but no kill. The technique-agnostic problem is being attacked: a March-2026 paper (Temperature Control of Digital Glass Forming) does real-time thermal-camera + data-driven dynamic-model control to keep glass in its working range, ML viscosity-temperature models exist (ViscNet), and there is marketing buzz (ReelMind/Corning) about AI thermal 'workable/critical' zone feedback for glassblowers - so this is NOT GAP_OPEN. However, none of these is the candidate's specific contribution: (1) the published glass temperature-control work targets industrial laser Digital Glass Forming, not artisan hand glassblowing, and uses a closed-loop controller, not a neural-operator forecast; (2) the AI-glassblowing-feedback claims are unverifiable marketing and only do current-state thermal classification, not a physics-surrogate forward rollout; (3) neural operators / PDE surrogates have never been pointed at hot-glass viscosity-field forecasting. The pairing of an SGNO-style PDE surrogate that rolls the viscosity/temperature field forward several seconds to give a gaffer 'reheat now' guidance is genuinely new, so the specific technique+framing survives - NARROW, not CLOSED.
